pages.title: Record Your Fragments
pages.text: Carry a Lore Handbook, then right-click while holding a fragment. Recording consumes one fragment and unlocks the story.$(br2)$(thing)Fragment 1$(): at trust 2, claim it with the handbook from Rewards.$(br2)$(thing)Fragment 2$(): search abandoned mineshaft and stronghold library chests.

pages.title: Fragments 3 & 4
pages.text: $(thing)Fragment 3$(): Zombie, Skeleton, Creeper, Spider, Witch and Enderman loot has a 5% chance to add this fragment.$(br2)$(thing)Fragment 4$(): progress through the End Ring story and successfully return to the Overworld.

pages.title: Fragments 5 & 6
pages.text: $(thing)Fragment 5$(): hunt Ghost Zombies, Ghost Skeletons and Ghost Creepers for a chance at the fragment.$(br2)$(thing)Fragment 6$(): stay still in the Overworld at night for about 20 seconds, without moving or turning. Valid time: 14000–22000. Leave inventory space.

pages.title: Fragments 7 & 8
pages.text: $(thing)Fragment 7$(): village house chests have a 10% chance.$(br2)$(thing)Fragment 8$(): End City treasure chests have a 30% chance.$(br2)Loot is resolved when generated. Reopening an old chest does not roll its rewards again.

pages.title: Fragments 9 & 10
pages.text: $(thing)Fragment 9$(): before receiving it, each sleep event has a 20% chance to grant it and trigger its story presentation.$(br2)$(thing)Fragment 10$(): Ancient City chests have a 30% chance. Prepare an escape route from the Warden.

pages.title: Fragment 11 & Beyond
pages.text: $(thing)Fragment 11$(): interact with a Glitch Villager.$(br2)First recordings track progress and grant trust. Duplicates can fill another handbook without another reward.$(br2)Read the full story in your Lore Handbook.
